people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.
translations.bsb: The Israelites were satisfied with the report, and they blessed God and spoke no more about going to war against them to destroy the land where the Reubenites and Gadites lived.
translations.kjv: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
translations.asv: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spake no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and the children of Gad dwelt.
